title: Midnighter Lot of 8 #7 8 9 11 12 13 16 17 Wildstorm 2007-2008 Vaughan Giffen
conditionDescription: #7: light scuffing, small spots near barcode. #8: small spot on cover. #9: back-cover scuffs and spotting. #11: back-cover edge wear, small corner crease. #12: back-cover edge wear and rubs. #13: light wear on back. #16 and #17: clean. Close-ups pictured.
descriptionText:
Midnighter (Wildstorm / DC Comics, 2006 series) - 8 issues. $2.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #7 (Jul 2007) - written by Brian K. Vaughan, art by Darick Robertson, Chris Sprouse cover. Light scuffing and small spots near the barcode (close-up pictured), light corner wear.
- #8 (Aug 2007) - written by Christos Gage, art by John Paul Leon, Chris Sprouse cover. Light wear and a small spot on the front cover.
- #9 (Sep 2007) - written by Jimmy Palmiotti and Justin Gray, art by Brian Stelfreeze, Chris Sprouse cover. Back cover has scuffs, light scratches and spotting on the white strip (close-up pictured).
- #11 (Nov 2007) - written by Keith Giffen, art by ChrisCross and Troy Hubbs. Back cover has edge wear and a small crease at the bottom right corner (close-up pictured).
- #12 (Dec 2007) - written by Keith Giffen, art by Rafa Sandoval, Chris Sprouse cover. Edge wear and color rubs on the back cover (close-up pictured).
- #13 (Jan 2008) - written by Keith Giffen, art by Ivan Landry and Rick Burchett, Chris Sprouse flag-mask cover. Light wear, mostly on the back cover's white strip.
- #16 (Apr 2008) - written by Keith Giffen, art by Chris Garbett and Rick Burchett, Garbett cover. Back cover: Lost Odyssey (Xbox 360) ad. Clean and bright.
- #17 (May 2008) - written by Keith Giffen, Chris Garbett American flag cover (the upside-down art is how it is printed).

The "CS KS" on the #7, #8, #9, #11, #12 and #13 covers is the printed artist signature.

Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
